name: Revenants
description: Companion evolution layer for continuous GNW/GRAO trace collection, monitoring, and LibraVDB promotion signals.

mutationRoot.description: Workspace/document root where approved doc and memory mutations should be written.

injectContext.description: Experimental opt-in. Leave false unless Revenants is explicitly allowed to inject context alongside LibraVDB.

registerContextEngine.description: Experimental opt-in. Leave false when LibraVDB owns the context engine slot.

contextEngineSlot.description: Required guard value before registering the experimental context engine.

queueMemoryProposals.description: Queue reviewed proposal signals for LibraVDB/agent review; does not directly mutate memory.

notifySessionOnProposal.description: When a new proposal is queued, post a compact review prompt back into the active session chat.

proposalNotifyTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for sending proposal review prompts back into chat.

proposalCooldownMs.description: Cooldown window for suppressing duplicate proposal signatures after they are queued, reviewed, or applied.

allowRawStatus.description: Development-only. Allows revenants_status includeRaw to return unredacted traces.
